description: Search the web with the Desearch Search API and return ranked pages, each with its title, URL, publication date when known, and the passage that best matches the query. Set page_text to add each page's full text. Returns { results, cost_usd, usage_count, service, currency }. Use search for titles and links only, and web-search for SERP-style snippets.

end_date.description: Only pages published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

highlights.description: Include the passage that best matches the query (API default true).

mode.description: 'fast' returns results sooner; 'balanced' (API default) favors relevance.

page_text.description: Include each page's full text (API default false).

query.description: Search query, example: 'Who won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics?'

start_date.description: Only pages published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: search-api
title: Search API
